ctx.x: When we left the Philippines, I didn't think it would be necessary to take at least a small supply of Kick-a-poo-joy juice with me. It was possible to get beer on the boat, but I was never a great beer drinker, although I did drink it now and then as a chaser. When we arrived in Japan there were no little or large shops anywhere that one could buy a bottle as had been the case in the Philippines, and that night, as I watched Ray Milland drinking in bars and at home, I knew where, he had hidden a bottle that he…
"Shorty" Matthews had begun to play drums not badly and our show made a hit with the soldiers and the Japanese personals that worked at the different camps.

Tokyo,like many other large cities,had its red light districts, and it was the most beautiful one I ever saw. When I was a kid in Cincinnati, there were certain streets where the prostitution business bloomed and it was the same in the other cities. But in Bombay and Egypt, there were special district. In Paris, they were called brothels and there was no particular street or district where they would be located.
